market_summary: Across all five assets during the 13:30 UTC macro news release, extreme two-sided volatility generated extended wicks and failed breakout probes past upper ATR bands. XAUUSD, EURUSD, US100, and BTCUSD all remain bounded within their session Value Areas, while GBPUSD's brief excursion above VAH was rejected back to the VWAP mean. With Cumulative Delta predominantly neutral or divergent and forming bars displaying corrective counter-wicks, discipline dictates HOLD across the board until post-news price action stabilizes.

signals.rationale: During the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session, XAUUSD trades inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20, VAH 3908.89, POC 3895.22) with signal close below POC and live price at 3882.46 testing VAL. CVD is -5.16 with a BEARISH label and negative slope (-1.68), agreeing with downside pressure. Price is trading below VWAP (3899.35) and below EMA50 (3895.80) after the signal candle spiked to 3905.66 testing the upper ATR band (3906.90) before suffering a sharp rejection on an RVOL spike of 2.803. The forming bar subsequently expanded toward the lower ATR band (3876.40), sweeping Session Low 3878.91 and S/R 3872.05 before bouncing. Due to extreme two-sided news volatility, conflicting wick extremes, and price stalling at VAL support, capital preservation favors standing aside.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / rejected VWAP and EMA50 with heavy upper wick
signals.level_event: sweep of Session Low 3878.91 and S/R 3872.05

signals.rationale: In the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session, EURUSD is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10527, VAH 1.10635, POC 1.10598) with signal candle close above POC, but live price at 1.10533 sliding back toward VAL. CVD prints +1,788 with a NEUTRAL label, showing lack of directional order-flow commitment. Signal bar closed above VWAP (1.10580) and EMA50 (1.10570) following a spike to 1.10693 that probed the upper ATR band (1.10667) and S/R 1.10662 on high RVOL of 3.019 (yellow spike), yet failed near Session High 1.10726. The forming bar immediately reversed below VWAP and EMA50 toward lower S/R 1.10543 and 1.10475. With conflicting two-way wicks and price oscillating inside the Value Area around POC, a clear edge is absent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / hovering near VWAP baseline amid two-way news wicks
signals.level_event: rejection of upper ATR 1.10667 and S/R 1.10662

signals.rationale: Operating in the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session, GBPUSD closed the signal candle above VAH (1.32374) and above POC (1.32345), but live price at 1.32359 has fallen back inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32251). CVD stands at +1,808 with a NEUTRAL label despite a positive slope, failing to provide strong directional confirmation. Price remains slightly above VWAP (1.32323) and EMA50 (1.32323). The signal candle breached the upper ATR band (1.32456) and tested Session High 1.32503 on a high RVOL spike of 3.703, but left an upper wick and rejected S/R 1.32431. The forming candle retraced toward S/R 1.32391 and the VWAP/EMA50 confluence. The failed expansion above VAH and swift re-entry into Value Area warrant a patient stance.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / failed breakout above VAH returning to VWAP
signals.level_event: rejection of Session High 1.32503 and S/R 1.32431

signals.rationale: During the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session, US100 is positioned inside the Value Area (VAL 28209.76, VAH 28412.58, POC 28264.08) with price above POC. CVD shows +1.57 with a NEUTRAL label, reflecting balanced pre-market delta. Price is trading above VWAP (28312.59) and above EMA50 (28293.16). The signal bar surged toward Session High 28513.99 and exceeded the upper ATR band (28413.52) before pulling back; RVOL printed 1.22, where the absence of a yellow RVOL spike on Dukascopy US100 tick volume is standard. The forming bar retested mid-channel near VWAP and S/R 28265.71. With the market remaining inside the session Value Area ahead of the New York cash open and showing two-sided news reactions, no directional breakout is confirmed.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / holding above VWAP and EMA50 baselines
signals.level_event: rejection of upper ATR 28413.52 and Session High 28513.99

signals.rationale: In the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session, BTCUSD trades inside the Value Area (VAL 68171.24, VAH 69802.27, POC 69219.76) with price above POC. CVD prints -0.05 with a BEARISH label, visibly diverging from the bullish price surge. Price holds above VWAP (69353.62) and above EMA50 (69463.13). The signal bar spiked past the upper ATR band (69818.70) and briefly cleared VAH to high 70156.40 on an RVOL spike of 2.225 (yellow bar), but closed back inside Value Area at 69726.90 below Prev Low resistance 71031.00. The forming candle pulls back toward EMA50. Given the sharp rejection of VAH and upper ATR combined with negative CVD divergence, the upside breakout is suspect.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / failed breakout above VAH with bearish delta divergence
signals.level_event: rejection of upper ATR 69818.70 and VAH 69802.27
